title: Trace metadata
description: Optional `trace` member of any JSON-RPC request, beside `params`. It is part of the signed body. A receiver ignores a missing or invalid value and never rejects a request because of it. It grants no access.

traceparent.description: W3C trace context, version 00 only. Lowercase hex, trace and span IDs not all zeros. The lowest flags bit is the sampling decision.
